fields.summary_ko.0: Warren Buffett, Chairman Emeritus (age 96), warned in a recent Thanksgiving letter that Berkshire Hathaway (BRKA -1.71%, BRKB -2.07%) stock has experienced three instances of approximately 50% declines over the past 60 years and may occur again in the future.
fields.summary_ko.1: Buffett advised not to despair during stock declines and to maintain long-term holdings while believing in U.S. economic recovery, citing the example of stock price that fell 50.7% from $147,000 in 1980 to $72,400 but has since recovered to $878,500.
fields.summary_ko.2: Currently, BRK.B has risen 17.5% monthly and is trading 5.4% below its 52-week high.
